name: Pinrow the Jet-Black Cat
blurb: Pinrow, a glossy jet-black shorthair with silver whiskers and gold eyes, lies long and flat on the warm stones of the garden path.

name: Bundle the Calico Cat
blurb: Bundle, a tidy calico with neat patches of black, ginger and white, gathers one of every garden treat into a single pile by the fence.

name: Bitsy the Dotted Cat
blurb: Bitsy, a white shorthair with neat rows of small black dots down her back and green eyes, lines up pebbles by the pond, row by row.
